## Send it

Copy this into `bot.ts` and run it. From WhatsApp Android, send `!breakout` to the bot.

```ts bot.ts
import { Client, html } from 'zaileys'

const client = new Client({ commandPrefix: '!' })

const card = html`
<!doctype html>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<style>
  :root { --pink: #ff4f8b; --orange: #ff8a3d; --yellow: #ffc93c; --lime: #9be15d; --mint: #2ed8a7; --sky: #38b6ff; --violet: #7c5cff; --ink: #1d1442; --cream: #fff8ec; }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  body { margin: 0; height: 100%; padding: 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; background: linear-gradient(165deg, #2b1c66, var(--ink) 60%); color: #fff; font: 14px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; overflow: hidden; }
  button { font-family: inherit; }
  header { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px; }
  .pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; min-height: 34px; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .12); font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .pill b { font-size: 16px; }
  .pill.score { background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); }
  #wrap { flex: 1; min-height: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; }
  #stage { position: relative; touch-action: none; border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(124, 92, 255, .55), 0 6px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, .35); }
  canvas { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; touch-action: none; }
  #overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 14px; background: rgba(29, 20, 66, .55); }
  #overlay[hidden] { display: none; }
  .panel { width: min(100%, 250px); padding: 16px; border-radius: 22px; background: var(--cream); color: var(--ink); text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 6px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, .3); animation: pop .3s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.6, .5, 1); }
  #title { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; }
  #hint { margin: 6px 0 14px; font-size: 14px; color: #4d4278; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .controls { flex: none; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.25fr 1fr; gap: 8px; }
  .btn { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--cream); color: var(--ink); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #b9a9e0; cursor: pointer; touch-action: none; transition: transform .08s, box-shadow .08s; }
  .btn:active, .btn.held { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #b9a9e0; }
  .btn.primary { background: var(--yellow); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #c98a06; }
  .btn.primary:active { box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #c98a06; }
  .btn:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; }
  #left, #right { font-size: 20px; }
  .btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }
  @keyframes pop { from { transform: scale(.8); opacity: 0; } }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .panel { animation: none; } .btn { transition: none; } }
  .sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); }
</style>
<header>
  <span class="pill score">Score <b id="score">0</b></span>
  <span class="pill">Level <b id="level">1</b></span>
  <span class="pill"><span aria-hidden="true">❤️</span><span class="sr">Lives</span> <b id="lives">3</b></span>
</header>
<div id="wrap">
  <div id="stage">
    <canvas id="board" role="img" aria-label="Breakout board"></canvas>
    <div id="overlay">
      <div class="panel">
        <div id="title">Breakout</div>
        <div id="hint">Drag on the board or hold the arrows to move. Clear every brick to level up.</div>
        <button id="play" class="btn primary" type="button" style="padding: 0 26px">Start</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="controls">
  <button id="left" class="btn" type="button" aria-label="Move left">◀</button>
  <button id="mid" class="btn primary" type="button" disabled>Launch</button>
  <button id="right" class="btn" type="button" aria-label="Move right">▶</button>
</div>
<div id="status" class="sr" aria-live="polite"></div>
<script>
  var TEXT = { start: 'Start', launch: 'Launch', pause: 'Pause', resume: 'Resume', over: 'Game over', won: 'You win! 🎉', again: 'Play again', serveHint: 'Tap the board or Launch', paused: 'Paused' };
  var W = 300, H = 330, STEP = 1 / 120, LEVELS = [220, 250, 285], LIVES = 3;
  var COLS = 7, ROWS = 6, BRICK_TOP = 40, SIDE = 12, GAP = 4, BRICK_H = 13;
  var BRICK_W = (W - SIDE * 2 - GAP * (COLS - 1)) / COLS;
  var PADDLE_W = 58, PADDLE_H = 10, PADDLE_Y = H - 26, PADDLE_SPEED = 330, R = 5;
  var ROW_COLORS = ['#ff4f8b', '#ff8a3d', '#ffc93c', '#9be15d', '#2ed8a7', '#38b6ff'];

  var canvas = document.getElementById('board');
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var stage = document.getElementById('stage');
  var wrap = document.getElementById('wrap');
  var overlay = document.getElementById('overlay');
  var titleEl = document.getElementById('title');
  var hintEl = document.getElementById('hint');
  var playBtn = document.getElementById('play');
  var midBtn = document.getElementById('mid');
  var statusEl = document.getElementById('status');

  var state = 'ready', score = 0, level = 0, lives = LIVES, bricks = [], sparks = [];
  var px = W / 2, ppx = px, hold = 0, dragX = null;
  var ball = { x: W / 2, y: PADDLE_Y - R - 1, px: W / 2, py: PADDLE_Y - R - 1, vx: 0, vy: 0 };
  var clock = 0, bannerUntil = 0, banner = '';

  function buildBricks() {
    bricks = [];
    for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      bricks.push({ x: SIDE + c * (BRICK_W + GAP), y: BRICK_TOP + r * (BRICK_H + GAP), color: ROW_COLORS[r], points: (ROWS - r) * 10, alive: true });
    }
  }

  function aliveCount() {
    var n = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < bricks.length; i++) if (bricks[i].alive) n++;
    return n;
  }

  function newGame() {
    score = 0;
    level = 0;
    lives = LIVES;
    buildBricks();
    px = W / 2;
    serve('Level 1');
  }

  function serve(text) {
    state = 'serve';
    ball.vx = ball.vy = 0;
    banner = text || '';
    bannerUntil = clock + 1.6;
    overlay.hidden = true;
    syncUi();
  }

  function launch() {
    if (state !== 'serve') return;
    var speed = LEVELS[level], angle = (Math.random() - .5) * .9;
    ball.vx = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
    ball.vy = -Math.cos(angle) * speed;
    state = 'playing';
    bannerUntil = 0;
    syncUi();
  }

  function circleHits(b) {
    var nx = Math.max(b.x, Math.min(ball.x, b.x + BRICK_W));
    var ny = Math.max(b.y, Math.min(ball.y, b.y + BRICK_H));
    var dx = ball.x - nx, dy = ball.y - ny;
    return dx * dx + dy * dy < R * R;
  }

  function hitBrick() {
    for (var i = 0; i < bricks.length; i++) {
      var b = bricks[i];
      if (b.alive && circleHits(b)) {
        b.alive = false;
        score += b.points;
        burst(b.x + BRICK_W / 2, b.y + BRICK_H / 2, b.color);
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  function burst(x, y, color) {
    for (var i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      var a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, v = 40 + Math.random() * 90;
      sparks.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * v, vy: Math.sin(a) * v, life: .5, color: color });
    }
  }

  // Ball moves one axis at a time so a brick hit knows which side it came from.
  function update(dt) {
    clock += dt;
    for (var s = sparks.length - 1; s >= 0; s--) {
      var sp = sparks[s];
      sp.life -= dt;
      sp.x += sp.vx * dt;
      sp.y += sp.vy * dt;
      sp.vy += 240 * dt;
      if (sp.life <= 0) sparks.splice(s, 1);
    }
    if (state !== 'serve' && state !== 'playing') return;
    if (dragX !== null) px = dragX;
    else px += hold * PADDLE_SPEED * dt;
    px = Math.max(PADDLE_W / 2, Math.min(W - PADDLE_W / 2, px));
    if (state === 'serve') {
      ball.x = px;
      ball.y = PADDLE_Y - R - 1;
      return;
    }
    ball.x += ball.vx * dt;
    if (ball.x < R) { ball.x = R; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    if (ball.x > W - R) { ball.x = W - R; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    if (hitBrick()) { ball.x -= ball.vx * dt; ball.vx = -ball.vx; }
    ball.y += ball.vy * dt;
    if (ball.y < R) { ball.y = R; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }
    if (hitBrick()) { ball.y -= ball.vy * dt; ball.vy = -ball.vy; }
    if (ball.vy > 0 && ball.y + R >= PADDLE_Y && ball.y - R <= PADDLE_Y + PADDLE_H && ball.x >= px - PADDLE_W / 2 - R && ball.x <= px + PADDLE_W / 2 + R) {
      var offset = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (ball.x - px) / (PADDLE_W / 2))), speed = LEVELS[level], angle = offset * 1.05;
      ball.vx = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
      ball.vy = -Math.cos(angle) * speed;
      ball.y = PADDLE_Y - R;
    }
    if (ball.y - R > H) {
      lives--;
      if (lives <= 0) { end(false); return; }
      serve(lives === 1 ? 'Last life!' : lives + ' lives left');
      return;
    }
    if (!aliveCount()) {
      if (level === LEVELS.length - 1) { end(true); return; }
      level++;
      buildBricks();
      serve('Level ' + (level + 1) + ' · faster ball');
    }
    syncUi();
  }

  function end(won) {
    state = won ? 'won' : 'over';
    titleEl.textContent = won ? TEXT.won : TEXT.over;
    hintEl.textContent = (won ? 'All ' + LEVELS.length + ' levels cleared. ' : 'Reached level ' + (level + 1) + '. ') + 'Score ' + score + '.';
    playBtn.textContent = TEXT.again;
    overlay.hidden = false;
    if (won) for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) burst(40 + Math.random() * 220, 60 + Math.random() * 200, ROW_COLORS[i]);
    syncUi();
  }

  var lastUi = '';
  function syncUi() {
    var key = [state, score, level, lives].join('|');
    if (key === lastUi) return;
    lastUi = key;
    document.getElementById('score').textContent = score;
    document.getElementById('level').textContent = level + 1;
    document.getElementById('lives').textContent = lives;
    midBtn.disabled = state !== 'serve' && state !== 'playing' && state !== 'paused';
    midBtn.textContent = state === 'playing' ? TEXT.pause : state === 'paused' ? TEXT.resume : TEXT.launch;
    midBtn.className = state === 'serve' || state === 'paused' ? 'btn primary' : 'btn';
    statusEl.textContent = state === 'over' || state === 'won' ? titleEl.textContent + ' Score ' + score + '.' : state === 'serve' ? 'Level ' + (level + 1) + ', ' + lives + ' lives' : '';
  }

  function rrect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    if (ctx.roundRect) ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r); else ctx.rect(x, y, w, h);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function layout() {
    var aw = wrap.clientWidth, ah = wrap.clientHeight, s = Math.min(aw / W, ah / H);
    stage.style.width = Math.floor(W * s) + 'px';
    stage.style.height = Math.floor(H * s) + 'px';
  }

  function draw(alpha) {
    var cssW = canvas.clientWidth, cssH = canvas.clientHeight, ratio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    if (!cssW) return;
    if (canvas.width !== Math.round(cssW * ratio) || canvas.height !== Math.round(cssH * ratio)) {
      canvas.width = Math.round(cssW * ratio);
      canvas.height = Math.round(cssH * ratio);
    }
    ctx.setTransform(ratio * cssW / W, 0, 0, ratio * cssH / H, 0, 0);
    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#2a1a63');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#170f38');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, .06)';
    for (var gy = 12; gy < H; gy += 24) for (var gx = 12; gx < W; gx += 24) ctx.fillRect(gx, gy, 2, 2);

    for (var i = 0; i < bricks.length; i++) {
      var b = bricks[i];
      if (!b.alive) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
      rrect(b.x, b.y, BRICK_W, BRICK_H, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, .35)';
      rrect(b.x + 3, b.y + 2, BRICK_W - 6, 3, 2);
    }
    for (i = 0; i < sparks.length; i++) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, sparks[i].life * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = sparks[i].color;
      ctx.fillRect(sparks[i].x - 2, sparks[i].y - 2, 4, 4);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    var x = ppx + (px - ppx) * alpha;
    var pg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, PADDLE_Y, 0, PADDLE_Y + PADDLE_H);
    pg.addColorStop(0, '#ffc93c');
    pg.addColorStop(1, '#ff8a3d');
    ctx.fillStyle = pg;
    rrect(x - PADDLE_W / 2, PADDLE_Y, PADDLE_W, PADDLE_H, 5);

    var bx = ball.px + (ball.x - ball.px) * alpha, by = ball.py + (ball.y - ball.py) * alpha;
    if (state === 'serve') { bx = x; by = PADDLE_Y - R - 1; }
    if (state !== 'ready' && state !== 'over' && state !== 'won') {
      if (state === 'playing') {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 79, 139, .35)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(bx - ball.vx * .025, by - ball.vy * .025, R * .8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(bx, by, R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    if (state === 'serve' || state === 'paused') {
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 248, 236, .95)';
      rrect(W / 2 - 110, 196, 220, 58, 16);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#1d1442';
      ctx.font = '800 17px system-ui, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(state === 'paused' ? TEXT.paused : (clock < bannerUntil && banner ? banner : 'Level ' + (level + 1)), W / 2, 215);
      ctx.font = '600 13px system-ui, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#4d4278';
      ctx.fillText(state === 'paused' ? 'Tap Resume to continue' : TEXT.serveHint, W / 2, 236);
    }
  }

  var last = 0, acc = 0;
  function frame(now) {
    if (!last) last = now;
    acc += Math.min((now - last) / 1000, .1);
    last = now;
    // Fixed physics steps keep the ball speed identical on 60 Hz and 120 Hz screens.
    while (acc >= STEP - 1e-9) {
      ppx = px;
      ball.px = ball.x;
      ball.py = ball.y;
      update(STEP);
      acc -= STEP;
    }
    draw(acc / STEP);
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  function worldX(e) {
    var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width * W;
  }

  var down = null;
  stage.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
    if (!overlay.hidden) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    if (stage.setPointerCapture) stage.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    down = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, t: Date.now() };
    dragX = worldX(e);
  });
  stage.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { if (down) dragX = worldX(e); });
  function release(e, tap) {
    if (!down) return;
    var moved = Math.abs(e.clientX - down.x) + Math.abs(e.clientY - down.y), quick = Date.now() - down.t < 300;
    down = null;
    dragX = null;
    if (tap && moved < 10 && quick) { if (state === 'serve') launch(); else if (state === 'paused') togglePause(); }
  }
  stage.addEventListener('pointerup', function (e) { release(e, true); });
  stage.addEventListener('pointercancel', function (e) { release(e, false); });

  function togglePause() {
    if (state === 'playing') state = 'paused';
    else if (state === 'paused') state = 'playing';
    syncUi();
  }

  function holdButton(id, dir) {
    var btn = document.getElementById(id);
    function stop() { if (hold === dir) hold = 0; btn.classList.remove('held'); }
    btn.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); hold = dir; btn.classList.add('held'); });
    btn.addEventListener('pointerup', stop);
    btn.addEventListener('pointerleave', stop);
    btn.addEventListener('pointercancel', stop);
    btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.detail === 0 && (state === 'serve' || state === 'playing')) px = Math.max(PADDLE_W / 2, Math.min(W - PADDLE_W / 2, px + dir * 30)); });
  }
  holdButton('left', -1);
  holdButton('right', 1);

  midBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { if (state === 'serve') launch(); else togglePause(); });
  playBtn.addEventListener('click', newGame);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { hold = -1; e.preventDefault(); }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { hold = 1; e.preventDefault(); }
    if (e.key === ' ' && e.target === document.body) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (state === 'serve') launch(); else if (state === 'playing' || state === 'paused') togglePause();
    }
  });
  document.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
    if ((e.key === 'ArrowLeft' && hold === -1) || (e.key === 'ArrowRight' && hold === 1)) hold = 0;
  });
  window.addEventListener('resize', layout);

  buildBricks();
  layout();
  syncUi();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
`

client.command('breakout', async (ctx) => {
  await ctx.send().htmlApp(card, {
    title: "Breakout",
    height: 450,
    device: ctx.senderDevice,
    fallback: "Breakout opens on WhatsApp Android only.",
  })
})
```

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Height | 450 px |
| Size | 15.9 KB |
| Input | Tap, Swipe |
| Download prompt | Skipped by the default `bypassDownload`. The card reloads when the recipient opens the keyboard, which starts it over; pass `bypassDownload: false` to keep its state |
| Tested | Not yet tested on a phone |

The card works only on WhatsApp Android, with no network or storage. Other devices get the `fallback` text. See [HTML apps](/messaging/html-app) for every option and limit.
